sustainability.heading: our commitment to sustainability
sustainability.body: Sustainability is foundational to how we cook and operate. We prioritize direct relationships with local farmers and producers, sourcing from within our regional foodshed to support a more resilient local food economy. In the kitchen, we pursue a zero-waste model — repurposing trim, preserving surplus, and designing menus that honor the entirety of each ingredient. Through these efforts, we aim to model a more thoughtful and connected way of cooking within our community.
